gpu: AMD gfx950 (MI350X-class, CDNA4), 8-GPU node; HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES pins the N shard GPUs
model_arch: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration (FULL multimodal checkpoint, 58.25 GiB; vision/audio towers present, text-only inference — multimodal warmup fails non-fatally)
attention_backend: TRITON_ATTN (forced by vLLM: Gemma4 heterogeneous head dims head_dim=256 / global_head_dim=512, FA4 unavailable)
status: SERVED — vLLM CAN serve Gemma-4-31B multi-GPU here at TP=2/4/8 on the 0.25.1 openai image (weights shard cleanly; the single-GPU weight-load crash is gone). This CONTRADICTS the prior finding in vllm-fp8-baseline.md, which was specific to the two OTHER images (rocm/vllm:latest TF4.57 fails config-parse; vllm-rocm-gemma4:latest TF5.14 crashes at weight-load). vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:latest (vLLM 0.25.1 / TF5.13.1) both resolves the multimodal gemma4 arch AND loads weights across TP.

sanity.method: greedy chat completion via /v1/chat/completions (applies the Gemma chat template + BOS)
sanity.primary_colors: Three primary colors are red, yellow, and blue.
sanity.note: COHERENT at every TP level via the chat endpoint. Raw /v1/completions (no chat template/BOS) degenerates ('France is France is ...') — standard Gemma-it behavior, NOT a broken serve. Decode TPOT is independent of output coherence (identical forward pass per token), so the random-dataset timings are valid.

notes: TTFT at ctx=1024 is anomalously high across all TP (280-348 ms) vs the 4k point — first-request torch.compile/cudagraph specialization artifact; decode TPOT is stable and is the reported metric.
vLLM TP=8 does NOT regress vs TP=4 here (6.38 vs 7.53 ms @1k) — opposite of plow, whose TP=8 crosses NUMA and regresses (15.81 vs 13.75). vLLM's all-reduce path absorbs the node0/node1 crossing.
Harness: perf-data/bench_vllm_tp.sh (TP knob). Per-point raw logs in perf-data/vllm_tp_logs/gemma_tp{2,4,8}_in{ctx}.log.
